change_policy: Immutable. Any change (engine config, decision rule, metric, n, criteria) is a NEW version with a NEW forward_start - never an edit of this file, never backdated.
family: H-EDGE2 v1 (market-first engine market_edge_v2, prospective first-sight shadow)
family_wise_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg on the one-sided PRIMARY p-values of the hypotheses in this family that have reached ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW, q <= 0.05. Secondary metrics are descriptive and never corrected into a pass.
status_note: CONFIRMED is never assigned by the evaluator (src/studies/edge2_forward.py). ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW means the sample is large enough for the owner to review the pre-registered criteria; the evaluator reports which criteria are met, the decision is the owner's.
interim_policy: No effect size, CI or p-value is published for a hypothesis before it reaches ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW (counts only), so the forward test cannot be stopped on a peek.

engine.hash_rule: sha256 of the file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF (identical on a Windows checkout and on raw.githubusercontent.com). If either hash differs from the registered value, every hypothesis is BLOCKED_CONFIG_CHANGED: rows produced by a different engine are not evidence for this one.
engine.not_the_proposed_params: v9 output/edge_engine_proposed_params.json (discovery-fitted, RETROSPECTIVE) is NOT what is tested here. This family tests the CURRENT committed config.

evidence_source.rows: selection_engine_version == market_edge_v2, FIRST SIGHT per (selection_engine_version, fixture_id, market): the earliest pre-kickoff row is kept, later runs never revise it
evidence_source.counted_rows: prediction_ts >= forward_start AND prediction_ts < kickoff_utc. Rows logged before forward_start (the shadow started 2026-10-25T09:25Z) are PRE_REGISTRATION_NOT_COUNTED.
evidence_source.two_sided_rows: market_source in {MEDIAN_TWO_SIDED_BOOKS, SINGLE_TWO_SIDED_BOOK} (same-book pairs only; a one-sided or missing price has no fair probability and is never scored)
evidence_source.settlement: full-time goals from Pro data/season_2026_27/team_match_stats, joined league-scoped through v9 src/team_names (resolve_result), unique match within +-1 day of match_date; anything else stays unsettled
evidence_source.side_a: OU25/OU15: OVER; BTTS: YES. p_decision and p_market_fair are converted to side A from the row's `side`.
evidence_source.gameweek: distinct ISO (year, week) of kickoff_utc among settled two-sided rows

decision_rule.states: market_edge_v2 decision_state exactly as logged: NO_BET / OBSERVE / QUALIFIED / STRONG (definitions in v9 src/market_edge.py and docs/EDGE_ENGINE_AUDIT_2026_10.md section 4)
decision_rule.QUALIFIED: ev_lower_bound > 0 AND >= 2 same-book two-sided books AND a track CLV record (n >= 50, clipped mean > 0 AND median > 0); caps: odds > 3.0 or |p_model - p_market_fair| > 0.20 -> at most OBSERVE
decision_rule.STRONG: QUALIFIED conditions AND prospective CLV evidence for this engine version (n >= 150, CI lower > 0). Unreachable at registration (no evidence file).

primary_metric.name: paired log-loss difference, decision vs de-vigged market
primary_metric.definition: per settled two-sided first-sight row: LL(p_decision_A) - LL(p_market_fair_A), all decision states. Negative = the engine's market-anchored probability beats the de-vigged market.
primary_metric.test: one-sided, H1: mean < 0. 95% CI and p from a matchday (kickoff date) block bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261026.

secondary_metrics: paired Brier difference (decision - market), same rows
calibration slope and ECE (10 bins) of p_decision_A and of p_market_fair_A

selection set (QUALIFIED/STRONG): n, certified CLV (book write within 30 min of kickoff, >= 3 two-sided books, power de-vig median; CLV% = odds * p_close_fair - 1) mean / median / positive % / coverage
selection set: flat 1u ROI with matchday block-bootstrap 95% CI, hit rate, max drawdown, longest losing streak
state counts (NO_BET / OBSERVE / QUALIFIED / STRONG) and two-sided coverage

promotion_criteria.PROBABILITY_LAYER_SUPPORTED: ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW AND primary CI upper < 0 AND BH q <= 0.05 within the family AND calibration slope of p_decision in [0.8, 1.2]
promotion_criteria.SELECTION_SUPPORTED: PROBABILITY_LAYER_SUPPORTED AND >= 150 settled selections (QUALIFIED/STRONG) AND certified-CLV coverage >= 50% AND CLV mean 95% CI lower > 0 AND ROI 95% CI lower > -5%
promotion_criteria.note: Neither is CONFIRMED and neither changes production. Production cutover additionally needs the owner's explicit approval (v9 change control) and a separate cutover plan.

rejection_criteria.REJECT: ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW AND primary CI lower > 0 (the engine's probability is worse than the market)
rejection_criteria.FUTILITY: settled two-sided n >= 2 x min_n AND primary mean >= 0

retrospective_context_not_evidence: v9 output/edge_engine_comparison.json (RETROSPECTIVE, 2026-08-15..10-22 first sight). It motivated the cells below and can never count toward a pass.

hypotheses.statement: On new-format O/U 2.5 first-sight rows, market_edge_v2's p_decision (de-vigged consensus + 0.10 x clipped logit residual) has lower log loss than the de-vigged market.
hypotheses.retrospective_context: RETROSPECTIVE: holdout 2026-09-27..10-22 (n 273) market LL 0.6799 vs w=0.10 LL 0.6777; discovery-fitted w=0.05 beat the market by -0.0011 LL, 95% CI [-0.0019, -0.0004]. Live shadow coverage at registration: 99/99 two-sided.
hypotheses.expected_accrual: ~110 first-sight fixtures/week -> min_n in ~5 weeks; min_gameweeks binds (8 weeks)

hypotheses.statement: On new-format BTTS first-sight rows, market_edge_v2's p_decision has lower log loss than the de-vigged market.
hypotheses.retrospective_context: RETROSPECTIVE: model vs power-devig market Brier gain +0.0002, CI [-0.0053, +0.0061]; discovery-fitted w did not beat the market on holdout (+0.0006 LL). The legacy BTTS-YES record (+26.3% ROI, n 133) is not evidence for this engine.

hypotheses.statement: On new-format O/U 1.5 first-sight rows WITH a same-book two-sided price, market_edge_v2's p_decision has lower log loss than the de-vigged market.
hypotheses.retrospective_context: RETROSPECTIVE: n 69 two-sided only; discovery-fitted w=0.45 holdout -0.020 LL, CI [-0.044, +0.002], BH q 0.052 - not significant, n tiny.
hypotheses.expected_accrual: SLOW: 7/99 two-sided on the live board (OddsAPI EU totals rarely quote Under 1.5). May need ~20 weeks.

hypotheses.statement: On standard-format O/U 2.5 first-sight rows, market_edge_v2's p_decision has lower log loss than the de-vigged market.
hypotheses.retrospective_context: RETROSPECTIVE: the market beats the model (Brier gain -0.0064, CI [-0.0115, -0.0005]); discovery-fitted w = 0.00 (no residual helps). Registered as the standard-format control: the expected result is FUTILITY or REJECT.

excluded_cells.standard|BTTS: not registered: retrospective decision LL equals the market (fitted w = 0.00), no prior signal; adding it only dilutes the family's BH correction
excluded_cells.standard|OU15: not registered: 0 of 84 standard fixtures had a two-sided O/U 1.5 price on the live board at registration
excluded_cells.OU35 (both tracks): blocked_families in the engine config - the engine never leaves NO_BET
